response.sql: SELECT SUM(state_total), AVG(invoice_count) FROM (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) as state_total, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) as invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate <= '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) subquery
